_readme: Operational settings for NUMA Studio, in one place. Brand facts live in brand/brand.json; this file holds the numbers the crew and scripts run on: model tiers, Higgsfield prices and budget, the Critic's rubric, render and loudness targets, the scheduled-task table, Instagram/Composio settings and the output formats. Each section's '_source' names the spec page (spec/SPEC.pdf, 'NUMA Studio - Product & Engineering Brief', Nov 12 2026) or says 'engineering default' when the spec gives no number. Scripts read it with numa_common.load_config(); agents and commands refer to these keys instead of hard-coding values.

models._source: spec p.38-39 (agent tiers: Director and Critic top tier, crews mid or small), p.39 and p.52 (keep model names in one config line). Values are the Claude Code model aliases.

effort.critic: fresh context (never sees the Director's or Editor's reasoning)

higgsfield._source: spec p.41-42 (plan, verified prices via get_cost on 2026-11-12, ranked uses), p.42 (Kling for people, Seedance people-free only, avoid Reframe), p.3 (cost per reel), p.17 and p.42 and p.48 (2-4 hero clips; REQUIREMENTS interpretation 14: 2-3 typical, 4 max)
higgsfield.recheck_rule: Re-check every price with get_cost before each job; prices change often.

prices.job: 5 s motion clip from a photo
Reframe a 20 s video to vertical
prices.note: Never use: the engine crops for free.

motion.note: Default for hero stills and anything with a person (bound as an Element, consent list only).

motion_draft.note: Draft at standard 720p; re-render only the keeper at pro.

signature_people_free.note: People-free spaces only: Seedance rejects photos with real faces; holds empty rooms steady for up to 30 s.

photo_extend.note: Only extend walls, floor, sky or background; never invent equipment or people.

music.note: Made to the reel's exact length and tempo.

budget._source: spec p.43 (monthly budget table and pacing rule), p.3 (150 credits per reel), p.48 (never exceed)

reserve.label: Reserve
reserve.buys: Virality checks, a surprise event, a bad week of re-rolls

pacing.rule: By day 15 of the month, no more than 55% of the monthly credits spent.

budget.note: Subscription credits reset monthly. Failed generations are usually refunded; finished-but-unwanted ones are not, so draft cheap and finalize keepers only.

critic._source: spec p.40-41 (scoring sheet, hard gates, pass rule), p.38-39 (loop capped at three rounds)
critic.score_formula: total = sum(weight * score / 5) over categories; maximum 100

rubric.label: Hook (first 1.5 s)
rubric.five_looks_like: Movement, a contrast visual and full-opacity hook text in frame zero; works muted; built to beat NUMA's median skip rate

rubric.label: Retention and pacing
rubric.five_looks_like: Every shot earns its time; no shot over 4 beats unless it's the emotional peak

rubric.label: Story clarity
rubric.five_looks_like: A stranger can say what the reel is about after one watch

rubric.label: Shareability
rubric.five_looks_like: A clear reason to send it to someone; a share line or a moment worth sending

rubric.label: Beat sync and transitions
rubric.five_looks_like: Every cut on a beat; one signature moment; transitions varied, not random

rubric.label: Captions
rubric.five_looks_like: Match the audio word for word, readable on a phone, clear of faces and the app's interface

rubric.label: Brand look
rubric.five_looks_like: NUMA's warm grade, type, logo end card; feels like the same studio every time

rubric.label: Audio mix
rubric.five_looks_like: Voice clear and natural, music under it, no harshness, consistent loudness

hard_gates: Anything on the claims policy's banned list, in the voiceover, on-screen text, visuals, caption or hashtags.
A recognizable person who isn't on the consent list.
Music with no recorded license source, or any trending song.
Audio silent, clipped, or not 48 kHz; video not 1080x1920.
NUMA misspelled, a wrong price, date or offer.
An AI shot with a warped face, hand, logo or text, or an AI shot that shows equipment or rooms NUMA doesn't have.
Black bars, mirrored edges or a frozen frame; content NUMA didn't make (collabs excepted); an AI-animated person without Instagram's AI label.

frames.rule: Every cut plus the first and last second
frames._source: spec p.40; REQUIREMENTS interpretation 13 (6-frame QA strip kept, separate 12-frame set)

critic.virality_predictor: Attached as a second opinion; never overrides the sheet.

render._source: spec p.18-19 (edit grammar, captions, first second, end card), p.46 (output sizes), p.48 (output spec, loudness, determinism); 'engineering default' where noted

safe_area.rule: Keep captions and text out of the top 12% and bottom 10% (Instagram's interface) and off faces.

hook._source: spec p.19, p.40; REQUIREMENTS interpretation 2 and 6

length_s._source: spec p.19, p.34, p.46, p.48; REQUIREMENTS interpretation 1

draft._source: engineering default (spec p.30, p.48: quick low-res draft mode for revisions)

render.determinism: Same inputs + same plan = byte-identical render: seeded grain, no other randomness (spec p.48).

pad._source: engineering default (spec p.5 failure table: natural sound plus a soft pad)

schedule._source: spec p.50 (scheduled tasks, Central time); command names from PLAN.md task T9

instagram._source: spec p.11 (publishing limits, container expiry), p.47-48 (Composio toolkit, scopes, API version, insights, metrics, posting), REQUIREMENTS interpretation 9 (72 h pull)
instagram.login: Instagram Login (no Facebook Page, no Meta app review for NUMA's own account)
instagram.graph_api_version_rule: Every Composio call sets graph_api_version to this value. Composio defaults to v21.0, which Meta retires on 2027-01-21.
instagram.not_in_composio_fallback: Graph API directly or Claude in Chrome

carousel._source: DECISIONS D21 (Claude Design carousels); engineering default
carousel.design_system_note: Link of NUMA's Claude Design design system (Artifact type "Design System"), e.g. https://claude.ai/artifact/<id>. When set, skills/numa-carousel installs it on every carousel canvas and builds with it; null = the bundled NUMA components (skills/numa-reel-editor/assets/carousel).

formats._source: spec p.46 (one reel, many outputs); REQUIREMENTS interpretation 1 (main reel 15-60 s); file names from docs/CONTRACTS.md

outputs.label: Reach cut-down
outputs.rule: The best 8-12 s of the same reel, new hook text
outputs.used_on: A second post later in the month, or a test variant

outputs.label: Story set
outputs.used_on: Stories the day after the reel

outputs.label: Carousel
outputs.used_on: Feed post on a non-reel day

outputs.label: Cover image
outputs.rule: Title kept inside the center 1080x1080 square so it reads in the profile grid

outputs.label: Copy
outputs.rule: Instagram caption, a one-line Story text, and a short paragraph for NUMA's email

formats.crop_rule: Crops for other formats are done in the engine, never with Higgsfield Reframe.
